provenance.basis: Portable project proposal, not site facts. Deployment must explicitly set gpu_type=h100, gpu_memory_gb>=80, gpus_per_node, cpus_per_task, memory_gb, node_cpu_limit and node_memory_gb; account mandatory. H100 supported by this adapter, not GPU-tested. Runtime checks do not establish support for other GPU models. Single-node only; 23h adapter maximum.
